name: Sbardella Orchards
description: A working pumpkin patch in 141 Manchester Road, NY, Sbardella Orchards grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples. The patch is busiest in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
